content:
The UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Main Examination Syllabus 2026 is for candidates preparing for the Veterinary Pharmacist recruitment for 1,308 posts.

Preparation Areas

  • Veterinary pharmacy and pharmaceutical science
  • Animal health, anatomy and physiology
  • Animal husbandry and livestock management
  • General knowledge and current affairs
  • General Hindi and relevant examination subjects

Download the official syllabus PDF below and follow the latest UPSSSC notification for the final examination pattern, marks and subject-wise instructions.
